findings.excerpt: title: "Frobenius normal two complement for S_3"
findings.symptom: The title displays S_3 with a literal underscore and baseline 3 instead of a typeset subscript.
findings.suggested_repair: Write the group name in inline math, e.g. $S_3$.

findings.excerpt: title: Brauer pair branching for c3 semidirect d8 in characteristic two
findings.symptom: The title renders the group names as plain lowercase c3 and d8, losing the standard group notation and semidirect-product symbol used by the example.
findings.suggested_repair: Use a math-formatted group expression such as $C_3\rtimes D_8$.

findings.excerpt: title: Classification of the irreducible unitary dual of SL2(R)
findings.symptom: The title renders SL2(R) as plain text without the standard subscript in SL_2 or blackboard-bold real field symbol.
findings.suggested_repair: Format the group name in math, e.g. $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{R})$.

findings.excerpt: title: Parabolic Mackey formula for finite GL_n
findings.symptom: The title renders GL_n with a literal underscore and baseline n instead of a typeset subscript.
findings.suggested_repair: Write the group name in inline math, e.g. $\mathrm{GL}_n$.
